notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for a queued timestamped ordinary interaction that survives Time Regulation disable and re-enable with a changed lookahead. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies lookahead, callback-before-grant ordering, interaction metadata, and terminal retraction behavior without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped SendInteraction, Time Regulation, Query Lookahead, Time Advance Request, and Retract declarations with FederateAmbassador receive, regulation, and grant callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timestamped interaction and Time Regulation declarations and FederateAmbassador callbacks
